# AgentBiz quant-research lavaan specification.
# Demonstration/specification only. This is not a fitted model.
# Declared engine lavaan with estimator ML. No estimator was executed.

model <- '
  # reverse-scored in data, not here: PU3
  PU =~ PU1 + PU2 + PU3
  # reverse-scored in data, not here: PEU3
  PEU =~ PEU1 + PEU2 + PEU3
  BI =~ BI1 + BI2 + BI3

  PU ~ PEU
  BI ~ PU
  BI ~ PEU
'
